name: Unified Safety Benchmark (USB)
description: USB is a comprehensive safety evaluation benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models, covering extensive risk categories and modality combinations. It evaluates both vulnerability to harmful queries and over-refusal to benign inputs using a sophisticated data synthesis pipeline and a combination of open-source and synthetic data.
reputation: A recent multimodal safety benchmark that is gaining attention for jointly testing harmful-content susceptibility and over-refusal in MLLMs.
notes: Includes 61 risk sub-categories with 4 modality combinations each; evaluates trade-offs between vulnerability and over-refusal; contains potentially harmful content.
